name: Yoppli Video Player Design
author: yoppli

sections.description:
Welcome to the most advanced video engine for WordPress. Discover how to combine tools to create foolproof marketing strategies, monetize with ads, and protect your content like an expert.

Additional Information: Free vs. PRO Version

Video Player Design is built to give you the most elegant and fluid video experience on WordPress. Whether you are running a simple blog or a complex digital business, our player adapts to your needs.

Here is a detailed breakdown of what you get with the Free version and the powerful tools waiting for you in the PRO upgrade:

🟢 FREE VERSION: The Essential Elegance

The free version is perfect for simple blogs, portfolios, or anyone looking to upgrade the boring native WordPress video player instantly.

What’s Included:
* Automatic Replacement Engine: Scans your “Posts” and “Pages” and automatically transforms any native .mp4 link or block into our sleek, dark, and fluid player.
* Custom Slugs Support: You can manually configure which URL slugs the player should actively scan.
* Unified Skin: A modern, dark aesthetic that makes your videos look professional.
* Basic Controls: Clean interface with a center Play icon and a bottom control bar (Play/Pause).
* Progress Bar: Fluid video navigation with a standard timeline.

👑 PREMIUM FEATURES (PRO VERSION)

💸 Advanced Ad Server
Monetize directly with native video ads (Pre/Mid/Post-Roll) or non-intrusive 90% banners. Full support for Google AdSense and VAST XML. Track earnings, views, and clicks with our live Dashboard. Build Ad Pods (commercial breaks) and set Smart Watchtime Frequency.

🛡️ Absolute Video Security & KYC
Create private creator sites with our KYC Audit Dashboard. Build custom registration fields and award “Verified Badges” from a VIP Audit dashboard.

🎨 10+ Premium Visual Themes
Transform your player with one click: MacOS Glass (floating controls), Neon Gradients, Netflix-style Cinema, or Pure Minimalist. Customize primary and secondary brand colors to perfectly match your site!

🕹️ Advanced UX & Marketing Tools
* Hover Preview: The video starts playing silently when users hover over it (Netflix style)—an ultra-effective visual hook.
* Smart Pause (Anti-Abandon): Automatically pauses the video if the user switches browser tabs, forcing visual attention (perfect for VSLs and Courses).
* Smart Memory: The player remembers exactly where the user left off and resumes seamlessly on their next visit.
* Picture-in-Picture (PiP) & Cast to TV: Let users float the video on their screen while reading an article, or cast it directly to their Smart TVs via Chromecast/AppleTV.
* Interactive Tools: Double-click for fullscreen, playback speed controls (vital for students), snapshot camera, and WhatsApp/Social sharing buttons.

🔌 Seamless Integrations
Fully compatible with WooCommerce (HPOS), LearnDash, Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and 100% translation-ready for Loco Translate and WPML. Our aggressive engine intercepts old shortcodes and transforms them flawlessly within visual builders.

👉 Ready to take your videos to the next level?
Discover the PRO Masterclass, explore business use-cases, and get your license at: https://yoppli.com/yoppli-video-player-design-pro/

screenshots.caption: General Settings - Control auto-replacement, AWS S3/Dropbox support, and global styling.
Design & Themes - Choose from multiple visual skins (Mobile, MacOS, TikTok) and customize brand colors.
Player Tools - Enable or disable specific player controls like Hover Preview, Smart Pause, and Social Share.
Ad Server Dashboard - Track global network performance, total earnings, views, and active campaigns in real-time.
Create Ads (Video/Banner) - Set up pre-roll, mid-roll, or post-roll ads with custom CTA info cards.
Ad Budget Control - Manage Cost Per View (CPV), Cost Per Click (CPC), and set automated campaign limits.
Ad Scheduling - Control ad status (Active/Paused) or schedule automatic activations.
Live Player Simulator - Preview exactly how your ad will look across PC, Tablet, and Mobile devices.
Playlists Manager - Group multiple videos into interactive series or courses with drag-and-drop ease.
Playlist Configuration - Customize thumbnail design, auto-play behavior, and progress tracking for series.
Front-End Login Popup - A beautiful glassmorphism popup to keep users on your site instead of redirecting to the default wp-login screen.
Front-End Registration Form - Allow new users to sign up seamlessly with an elegant, conversion-optimized registration overlay.
Security Vault (PIN) - Let users lock their sub-profiles with a 4-digit PIN for parental control or privacy.
KYC Field Builder - Create custom registration fields (text, file uploads, country codes) required for access.
Reports Center - An animated radar dashboard where admins manage user-submitted video error tickets.
Access Control by Role - Define exactly which WordPress roles can access the premium dashboard.
Dynamic Dropdown Menus - Inject custom WP Menus into the user profile dropdown based on their role.
Profile Images & Albums - Upload your own images to create Netflix-style avatar galleries for users.
Sub-Profiles Management - Users can easily switch between their sub-profiles (e.g., Kids vs. Adults).
Profile Editor - Allow users to update their name, avatar, and security PIN directly from the front-end.
Frontend Billing Dashboard - Users can manage their active subscriptions and update their payment methods.
Frontend Payment History - Complete transaction log showing invoices, dates, and payment status.
Frontend Active Devices - Allow users to view and log out from connected devices remotely.
Custom Player Settings (User View) - The user can select their preferred visual theme directly from their dashboard.
Personal Settings Hub - Complete account oversight from changing emails to updating avatars.
Live Video Player (MacOS Theme) - See the player in action with the floating MacOS Glass theme applied.
Live Ad Banner Overlay - A bottom 90% banner ad running natively over the video content.
VIP User Dashboard - A complete visual representation of the frontend portal for authenticated users.
Custom Registration Fields - Display custom KYC fields like Phone Number during the sign-up process.
reCAPTCHA v3 Integration - Secure your custom frontend login and registration popup against spam and bots.
Elementor & Visual Builders - Insert the player effortlessly using a dedicated shortcode block.
Native Gutenberg Block - Embed and configure the video player instantly using a custom-built WordPress block editor component.
Gutenberg Video Ads Setup - Set up pre-roll video advertisements and target URLs directly from the block settings panel.
Gutenberg Banner Overlays - Easily toggle and upload bottom-overlay banner ads without touching a single line of code.
Classic Editor Shortcodes - Insert the player effortlessly into older WordPress posts using clean, parameter-rich shortcodes.
Shortcode Ad Configuration - Control complex video and overlay ad campaigns using simple shortcode attributes in any editor.
PHP Theme Integration - Dynamically embed the video player directly into your custom WordPress theme files for full developer control.
Front-End Security Center - Empower users to manage their passwords and remotely log out unrecognized active devices.
Front-End Billing Management - Users can review their active subscription plan, payment methods, and complete transaction history.
Front-End Profile Settings - A centralized hub where users can update personal data, edit their avatars, and access security features.
Front-End Style Gallery - Let users personalize their account area with exclusive background themes or their own custom uploads.
Premium User Dashboard - A personalized front-end hub where users can seamlessly manage their subscriptions, security settings, and family profiles.
Front-End Profile Editor - Allow users to dynamically update their personal details, international phone numbers, and avatars directly from their dashboard.
Custom Interface Themes - Provide users with a visual gallery to select exclusive background designs or upload custom images to personalize their workspace.
User Activity Log - Let users track their viewing history in real-time, apply advanced date filters, and delete specific records for complete privacy.
PIN Security Vault - Enable sub-profile protection with an interactive 4-digit PIN pad to restrict access and ensure parental control.
Advanced Security Center - A powerful user hub to change passwords, monitor live device connections, and remotely log out unauthorized sessions.
Comprehensive Billing Dashboard - Give users front-end access to their active subscription status, payment methods, and a detailed transaction history.
KYC Audit Dashboard - Administrators can view a complete table of users, check their verification statuses, and inspect submitted compliance documents.
Document Verification System - Review individual user submissions and easily approve, reject, or mark custom KYC fields and files as pending.
KYC Compliance Rules - Define strict access locks for incomplete profiles and automatically award verified badges to fully approved users.
Video Ad Campaigns - Create and configure highly targeted pre-roll, mid-roll, or post-roll video advertisements.
Ad Skip Controls - Set precise skip behaviors, forcing viewers to watch or allowing them to skip after a custom duration.
Call-to-Action Settings - Enhance video ads with interactive CTA buttons, tracking URLs, and custom display text to drive conversions.
Banner Overlay Ads - Easily design and place non-intrusive image banners that hover directly over your playing video content.
Live Ad Simulator - Instantly preview your video and banner ads in a simulated player environment before pushing them live.
Ad Performance Analytics - Monitor your campaign success in real-time with a dashboard tracking total views, clicks, and CTR.
Interactive Playlists - Group multiple videos into engaging courses, episodic series, or collections with a dedicated manager.
Drag-and-Drop Episodes - Organize playlist content effortlessly by reordering videos and assigning custom titles and thumbnails.
Playlist Visual Configuration - Fine-tune the playlist appearance, including layout styles, continuous autoplay logic, and scroll behaviors.
Front-End Playlist Player - Deliver a premium, Netflix-style viewing experience with a sleek, integrated side menu for episodes.
Error Reports Dashboard - Centralized admin panel to track, manage, and resolve all user-submitted video playback issues and content flags.
Front-End Bug Reporting - Allow viewers to easily flag broken videos or playback errors directly from within the video player interface.
Interactive Report Form - A sleek, modal-based reporting tool that captures precise user feedback without forcing them to leave the page.
Detailed Ticket Inspector - Open and review individual user reports with deep context, including the exact video URL and viewer comments.
System Diagnostic Logs - Access an advanced critical error log to effortlessly debug server issues, API connection failures, and system conflicts.
WooCommerce Integration - Seamlessly connect your video platform with WooCommerce to sell premium access and manage recurring subscriptions.
Membership Plan Mapping - Link specific WooCommerce products directly to your custom VIP plans to automate premium account upgrades.
Subscription Limits Control - Define exact account constraints, such as the maximum number of family profiles allowed for Free versus VIP users.
Granular Access Permissions - Restrict or grant specific dashboard modules (Themes, Security, Billing) based on the user's active membership tier.
Dashboard Shortcode Deploy - Quickly deploy the entire front-end account ecosystem to any page using a simple, universal shortcode.
Seamless Floating Video (PiP) - Enable Picture-in-Picture mode so viewers can continue watching your content while scrolling through the page.
Automatic Updates & Licensing - Securely activate your license key to receive one-click updates and premium support directly from the dashboard.
Advanced Content Protection - Prevent unauthorized downloads and piracy by enabling strict right-click disabling and video source encryption.
Responsive Mobile Design - Ensure a flawless, touch-friendly viewing and account management experience across all smartphones and tablets.
